name: Apple Snow
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Pare, quarter, and core four sour apples, steam until soft, and rub through sieve; there should be three-fourths cup apple pulp.
Beat on a platter whites of eggs until stiff (using wire whisk), add gradually apple sweetened to taste, and continue beating.
Pile lightly on glass dish, chill, and serve with Boiled Custard.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
